description: Load-following model with xenon-135 dynamics and ramp rate constraints (~1%/min, slightly slower than PWR)

unit.name: Generic 3300 MWth / 1100 MWe BWR (BWR/6 class)
unit.source: Todreas & Kazimi (2012), Nuclear Systems, 2nd ed., CRC Press; GE BWR/6 reference; Aron (1969), Nucl. Sci. Eng.; NEA/CSNI (2011) BWR Load-Following

P_thermal_mw.note: Reactor core thermal power at full load

ramp_rate_limit_pct_min.note: Maximum allowed power ramp rate for BWR (~1%/min, slower than PWR due to two-phase flow stability constraints and void fraction feedback)

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable BWR PLR (limited by recirculation flow and void fraction stability)

total_reactivity_margin_pcm.note: Total control rod + recirculation flow reactivity margin (BWR somewhat lower than PWR)

xenon_reactivity_coeff_pcm.note: Reactivity penalty at equilibrium Xe at full power (BWR slightly lower than PWR due to different spectrum)

void_coeff_pcm_per_pct_void.note: Void reactivity coefficient (negative -- inherent safety feedback, unique to BWR)
